claims.failure_mode: Dissociation-induced stress transcriptome (HSPA1A/FOS/JUN class) floods screen, hijacking evidence window
claims.mitigation: Check stress separation score before reading; prioritize cold protease/short dissociation/on-ice operation for dissociation protocols (supported by Tier B literature); clusters containing stress flooding excluded from external naming.

claims.failure_mode: MG↔Astro difficult to distinguish on evidence surface (macroglia granularity wall), dictionary misleading readings have precedent
claims.mitigation: Mutual labeling of macroglia two classes must carry 'granularity wall' annotation; MG entry prohibits ambiguous co-expressed genes like GLUL/VIM/CLU (KB7 revision done); Astro/MG determination upgraded to manual re-review item in DR reactive gliosis (GFAP↑) scenarios.

claims.failure_mode: snRNA vs scRNA platform axis composition suppresses spectrum: applying nuclear suspension baseline to cell suspension data generates systematic false flags
claims.mitigation: Composition controls must be routed by platform stratification (RC layering proven to fix cross-design false flags: Q1 Rod 62.15 returns to intra-layer interval); pool-level flags in mixed designs are boundaries for stratification applicability, not data errors.

claims.failure_mode: Donor leverage: rare class hits can flip upon deletion of a single donor
claims.mitigation: Attach leverage donor proportion to hit units; flag level for 'flip upon single donor deletion' (suggested tier see checklist, PI decision); external conclusions require support from ≥2 donors.

claims.failure_mode: MG ambiguous abbreviation (Müller glia vs microglia) collides across systems, bare writing in deliverables causes naming ambiguity
claims.mitigation: Prohibit bare 'MG' in any deliverable—always use Müller glia / microglia full names or CL number anchoring (this library's CL:0000636=Müller cell is the correct solution verified via OLS number-by-number back-check in KB5v3, Astro=CL:0000127; citing other libraries' CL numbers requires OLS back-check, memory prohibited).

claims.failure_mode: Surgical specimen blood influx: myeloid/platelet/neutrophil signatures mix in; counting myeloid proportions without first reporting blood-lineage vs resident layers = conclusion contamination (platelet/neutrophil anchors near-blood-only; monocyte-layer anchors reach lineage only, blood-vs-recruitment direction needs flag check)
claims.mitigation: Before myeloid counting, report the 'blood-lineage vs tissue-resident' layers (resident anchors SELENOP/MRC1/FOLR2/CD163 vs classical-monocyte anchors FCN1/LYZ/S100A8-9); both anchor sets reach the lineage layer only, not the origin layer — FCN1/LYZ aliases with surgical blood influx and disease-recruited monocytes share the signature, SELENOP/FOLR2 also occur in perivascular macrophages, origin assertions are capped at transcription similarity (priors clause registered; must be paired with blood-contamination flag checks); apply PBMC-paired deduction when a paired PBMC control exists (no paired blood sample in the GSE165784 library yet; forward-looking rule); external wording must not write 'macrophages X%' bare without the blood-lineage caliber.

claims.failure_mode: Disease material ≠ healthy organ: using disease samples against healthy tissue composition as a 'benchmark' misreads material category
claims.mitigation: Baseline for membrane samples has only three uses (identity reference/background control/QC flag); prohibited as benchmark; off-list identities trigger unexpected flag but retain original judgment; use PDR-specific prior (established) not healthy retina grid for comparison anchor.

claims.failure_mode: Composition opposite in different chambers for same disease (PDR vitreous T lineage vs membrane myeloid lineage), citation cross-contamination = conclusion reversal.
claims.mitigation: 'PDR+single-cell' wording must include material term (membrane/vitreous/retina); two grid pitfall cards cross-reference; cross-material comparison limited to pathway layer, not proportion layer.

claims.failure_mode: Writing FVM/myeloid claims without literature anchors (method + composition bibliographic pool) renders sources untraceable.
claims.mitigation: When writing FVM/myeloid claims, cite the aforementioned anchors; PMID:39512888 can serve as a control for this lab's wet-lab protocols.

claims.failure_mode: Failure to verify gene ID systems before cross-species paneling → feature space synonymy, panel hit rate drops to zero (0/2000 incident)
claims.mitigation: Verify var ID system (head(20) visual inspection) before any cross-species paneling; bridge = formal ortholog table + case-insensitive matching; force persist per-sample per-gene miss lists, read output under panel-incomplete protocol.

claims.failure_mode: Gene capitalization convention collisions (human all caps/mouse first letter cap) cause species flag misjudgment and join failures
claims.mitigation: Symbol matching always .str.upper() then join + ortholog table (HGNC/MGI official mapping); any panel hit rate <50% requires checking capitalization/ID system before discussing biology.

claims.failure_mode: Vendor SingleR mouse-retina reference labels Müller cells as Astrocytes (observed in-library via BMR; vendor conventions not exhaustively audited): cross-system annotation drift
claims.mitigation: Mouse side always use full names (Müller glia / microglia) or CL IDs; build a lexicon crosswalk before cross-species comparison (dr-sc re-annotation crosswalk follows the same sha discipline); compare with vendor annotations only after mapping.

claims.failure_mode: sklearn proba column order follows alphabetical order of classes_ rather than custom class order: guessing columns = completely reversed results
claims.mitigation: Print classes_ to align columns before consuming any sklearn probability output; META.predict_proba_note fixed disclosure (mouse side attached); prohibit guessing columns based on external class tables.

claims.failure_mode: Broad non-specific brightness of epithelial/secretory markers: single-gene classification is compromised by cross-lineage non-specific brightness
claims.mitigation: Secretory class reading prohibits single-gene classification: requires core gene combination + cross-lineage non-specific brightness pre-check (downgrade if out-of-cluster class expression rate > threshold); LACRT-type 'ambient positive reading line' registered as next-round goal design item (KBX O3).

claims.failure_mode: Immune dominant group carries a strong material/chamber component (not purely a disease attribute — material and disease effects may stack): same disease different materials (membrane myeloid vs vitreous T lineage).
claims.mitigation: Citing PDR immune maps must include chamber term (three grids: membrane/vitreous/retina); cross-chamber integration only done at patient level (paired samples), no averaging of class proportions.

claims.failure_mode: Platform self-reported wording (single-nucleus suspension/cell suspension) inconsistent with actual preparation → nucleus-cell platform axis misattribution: ambient correction and rare-class priors applied inversely based on wrong platform.
claims.mitigation: Platform entries confirmed face-by-face via primary abstract + GEO series explicit text; annotations/headers serve only as clues; conflict between measured and self-reported → register correction without modifying originals; consumer side must confirm face-by-face once before nucleus-cell axis application.

claims.failure_mode: Mixed sampling/sorting sub-designs within same dataset (unsorted arm pooled with positive/negative immune sorting arms) without metadata characterization → stratification comparability broken, systematic bias in sorted arm composition treated as whole-dataset fact
claims.mitigation: Sample-level preparation strategy forensic table before pooling (cellId prefix/abstract method/sorting marker three columns); composition metrics for non-stratifiable datasets descriptive only, not comparable; pre-registered rules not retroactively changed by forensics, splitting as subsequent option

claims.failure_mode: Sorting/plate-based suspensions physically do not carry target cell types → 'zero detection' in re-computation layer misread as biological absence or entry missing, actually a detection channel gap
claims.mitigation: Before concluding 'cell type absence', pass preparation sensitivity screening (check sorting markers/plate aperture design); if platform does not carry → register as detection gap, prohibit named biological absence

claims.failure_mode: Treating a 'pilot face' with single study/no donor-level intervals as a composition control reference converts single-batch bias into systematic false flags, with no donor-level confidence bands available for check
claims.mitigation: Automatically attach coverage/panel_gap flags before pilot/single-study faces enter composition controls; composition scoring disabled, description only; panel supplementation candidates converted to construction line work orders

claims.failure_mode: Fetal/developmental stage samples mixed into adult tissue reading surface: developmental signatures hijack annotation and age axis, causing developmental cell types to be mislabeled or rare classes flattened under adult vocabulary
claims.mitigation: Stage orthogonal axis determination precedes naming (S0 hard gate): fetal/developing suspected samples → abstain/separate list, prohibited strong naming under adult vocabulary; report grouped by stage before reading surface

claims.failure_mode: Ambient RNA/droplet crosstalk systematically disrupts sample assignment and rare population inference in combinatorial indexing and multi-omics experiments—crosstalk artifacts manifest as 'low-abundance cell types'
claims.mitigation: Pre-demultiplexing ambient forensics (multi-reference mapping/empty droplet controls); report sensitivity of rare class conclusions to ambient correction methods; default downgrade handling for multi-omics components

claims.failure_mode: Demultiplexing/ambient tools dependent on mitochondrial genotype suffer silent bias due to genotype incompatibility when pooling humans-apes and other closely related species; genotype-based attribution fails.
claims.mitigation: Check MT genotype compatibility before cross-species pooling (tool documentation + reference mitochondrial genome version); incompatible → switch to SNP/hashtag attribution; reuse preflight discipline from cross_species_panel_id_preflight for homologous lessons.

claims.failure_mode: Organoid/iPSC-derived systems framed with adult tissue: system developmental signatures mistaken for adult cell type evidence, organ-level references further contaminate adult type definitions and training references
claims.mitigation: Before naming and training references, distinguish the system axis (organoid/iPSC vs in situ tissue); if no 'system' term is present, leave scope blank and register a gap (to be backfilled after C11/C9 vocabulary expansion); organ-level references must not solely define adult cell types

claims.failure_mode: Direct transfer of model species maps/vocabulary to human (or vice versa) as cell type reference: structural and molecular differences exist in homologous tissues, transfer produces 'pseudo-absent/pseudo-present' cell types.
claims.mitigation: List homologous structure comparison table item-by-item before reference transfer (including species-exclusive type lists); citing model species vocabulary must include species axis annotation; same family as symbol_case/panel_id_preflight but different failure surface (reference transfer ≠ ID conflict).

claims.failure_mode: Plate-based/low-input protocols: plate-level background (thousand-CPM) makes low-expression secretory markers read as false positives — background is a protocol attribute, not lineage expression
claims.mitigation: Register a data_note_ambient positive-read line before positive readings of low-expression entries; positive readings without background quantification downgrade to soft hint; background table and read line shipped together (KB8 hard-wired discipline)

claims.failure_mode: Red/green verdicts of minority reference groups are fired by neighbor-class large pools (pool(C)≠pool(O)): verdicts reflect control-pool size, not target group discriminability
claims.mitigation: Minority group (<10k) verdicts must report both pool sizes pool(C)/pool(O); red/green marked unreliable if mismatch exceeds one order of magnitude; conclusions about minority types like RPE must go through independent panels (KC-B1-006 same family, generalization face)

claims.failure_mode: Naive cross-species integration collapses into one heterogeneous mega-cluster plus single-species tiny clusters: the mixed state is an integration failure mode, not cross-species conservation
claims.mitigation: Cross-species integration first passes three-state joint judgment (mixture degree/single-species share/ARI); failure baselines kept on file as controls; success declared only after audited ortholog-space pipeline (M2 three-threshold discipline)

claims.failure_mode: Post-integration per-sample composition residual bias is read away: cross-sample cluster merging dilutes disease-cohort differences into the main cluster; merged labels do not eliminate the residual
claims.mitigation: Post-integration must report per-sample composition tables; cluster labels never substitute per-sample shares; disease-cohort conclusions recomputed on the single-sample track (dual-track retained)

claims.failure_mode: Vendor coarse bins mix cross-class signal: coarse reference boxes (e.g., vendor Epithelial box) mix non-target epithelium/contamination signals; aligning against coarse boxes yields fake-diff or fake-match deviations
claims.mitigation: Vendor coarse-bin alignment only to mapping caliber (KC-B1-024 same family); coarse bins without corresponding classes listed NA without extrapolation; coarse-bin deviations first attributed to bin definition before biological reading

claims.failure_mode: Governance gates silently reject legitimate inputs: species/ID convention differences make the gate reject true-type samples (title-case human-origin sends hitting the mouse-suspected branch); false rejections do not enter the result surface
claims.mitigation: Every governance gate ships a false-rejection observation window + dual-state control ledger; false rejections counted and reported separately; if misdetect>0, revert per process, no unilateral caliber change

claims.failure_mode: Missing treatment record is read as untreated (not_recorded ≠ naive): donor/eye-bank metadata has no treatment column, drug exposure history may genuinely exist, and the treatment axis is blind-read
claims.mitigation: Treatment axis registered three-state; not_recorded must not be used as naive control (C12 mandatory mitigation); treatment-effect comparisons first check metadata treatment-column availability, absent → downgrade to descriptive

claims.failure_mode: Eye-bank ex-vivo material and surgical fresh material mixed into one composition surface: death-to-fixation interval, preservation and surgical context differ systematically; pooling reads preservation effects as tissue biology
claims.mitigation: Composition claims carry material-source words (eye-bank/surgical flap/ex-vivo whole) and intervals; two sources listed separately, never pooled; cross-study comparisons first align material caliber (KC-B1-016 three-usage caliber same family)

claims.failure_mode: One GEO series mixes disease/normal/age layers and metadata cannot be completed: the QUARANTINE layer is discarded (8,178/23,178 scale), losing composition comparability — discard volume is a comparability loss not cleanup
claims.mitigation: Series-level splitting (stage/disease layers) precedes composition comparison; QUARANTINE layers not silently discarded; cross-dataset donor ID overlap checked before claiming independence

claims.failure_mode: Optic nerve head (ONH/lamina cribrosa) and optic nerve shaft (ON) have different structure and cell composition: merging into one 'optic nerve' composition surface reads structural region differences as biological composition
claims.mitigation: Optic nerve claims first lock region words (ONH/ON/mixed); mixed-region composition described only, not benchmarked; sampling boundary recorded; glial composition comparisons stratified by region

claims.failure_mode: Doublets inflate false error clusters: high-doublet-fraction clusters (scrublet score median >0.4 level) are misread as 'class errors' — the failure is doublet composition, not classifier misbehavior for that class
claims.mitigation: Error-cluster attribution first passes doublet-score crosstab (T125 style); high-dbl clusters do not drive rule changes; doublet rate reported jointly with rare-class support

claims.failure_mode: Public-dataset lineage is invisible: HRCA constituent/pooled donors reappear under different GSE/SUP accessions; nominally independent evaluation sets are actually resub of the training pool
claims.mitigation: External evaluation sets first pass donor/barcode lineage check (not accession-level); resub layers barred from evaluation surfaces; pairwise match ledgers retained

claims.failure_mode: Query-rewrite layer structural deletion: whole-sentence replacement rules lose substantive meaning in the rewritten surface (31/66 rows registered), while ON-arm hit improvements mask the meaning loss
claims.mitigation: Rewrite layers pass per-row substantive-meaning audits (not just hit rates) before promotion; structural defects patched at the rule layer, not by parameters; ON/OFF control surfaces kept as verdict surfaces

claims.failure_mode: Retinal pigment/photoreceptor-layer signals in vitreous material have a second disease channel: in PVR contexts pigment-cell migration/proliferation is pathology itself (macrophage-myofibroblast transition registered); reading 'sampling flag only' flags disease body as contamination
claims.mitigation: Disease-context words precede reading of pigment-layer signals (first verify PVR/tear context); dual-hypothesis registration (sampling flag and pathology channel reported in the same sentence); specimen records without sampling method still barred from the conclusion pool

claims.failure_mode: Vitreous immune-cell detectable surface is protocol-dependent: cassette washing vs membrane peeling vs flow+single-cell workflow differ in yield and subset retention; cross-protocol composition comparison compares extraction protocols, not biology
claims.mitigation: Vitreous composition claims reported per protocol layer (KC-B1-045 three questions extended by a protocol fourth question); cross-protocol comparisons only to pathway layer

claims.failure_mode: Aging atlas conclusions transferred directly across species: human and macaque aging retina registered in one atlas while the two-species aging-signature correspondence is an open question; mouse/macaque aging module conclusions cannot be read as human cell-type-specific effects without verification
claims.mitigation: Cross-species aging claims first build a human-model-species module correspondence table (including failure faces); aging conclusions default to pathway layer; cell-type-specific conclusions verified in the same atlas before transfer

claims.failure_mode: Rabbit stromal wound-repopulation model conclusions transferred directly to the human fibrosis window: the registered rabbit non-fibrotic repair pathway differs from human pathological fibrosis; model→human direct read-out is reference-transfer failure
claims.mitigation: Rabbit-model references first list the non-fibrotic/fibrotic window difference; rabbit material data not admitted to human corneal composition comparison surfaces; grid-build duty transferred to construction line

claims.failure_mode: Overcorrection erases true biological variance: batch correction flattens between-group composition differences along with batch effects; post-correction 'uniformity' is falsely read as 'no difference'
claims.mitigation: 'No difference' conclusions across datasets report correction strength (overcorrection sensitivity); uncorrected-track controls kept (dual-track); disease-effect claims prefer within-dataset stratified analysis

claims.failure_mode: Non-diabetic uveitis vitreous composition has thin single-cell evidence: mediator/proteomic review-layer conclusions are not the composition comparison surface — review conclusions and single-cell composition cannot substitute each other
claims.mitigation: Non-diabetic vitreous composition claims first verify evidence layer (mediator layer ≠ composition layer); composition-layer statements need single-cell support; grid absence registered as build duty

claims.failure_mode: Bulk tissue composition read back to cell-type-specific mechanisms: bulk averaging masks cell-type attribution; deconvolution-vs-single-cell registered differences show bulk conclusions cannot directly read as cell-type evidence
claims.mitigation: Bulk composition conclusions default to pathway/tissue layer; cell-type-specific statements need deconvolution+sensitivity analysis and are labeled inference; when matched single-cell evidence exists, single-cell layer preferred (KC-B2-001 wording-drift same family)
